# AGENTS.md (Vendor)

This directory contains the vendored OpenSSL 3.x source tree managed by `subtree.yaml` (remote `openssl/openssl`, tag `openssl-3.6.2`).

## Boundaries (strict)

- Do not edit files under `Vendor/**` unless explicitly asked to patch vendored code.
- Prefer updating vendored code via the subtree CLI rather than manual edits.
- If you need to change behavior, prefer making the change upstream and then updating the subtree.

## If you must patch (explicit request only)

- Keep changes minimal and tightly scoped.
- Avoid reformatting, renaming, or sweeping refactors.
- Verify the subtree entry in `subtree.yaml` (remote / tag / commit) before editing.
- Ensure changes remain upstream-syncable against the pinned tag.

## Update procedure

### Minimal recipe (patch releases — e.g., 3.6.0 → 3.6.2)

```bash
# 1. Bump the subtree to a new tag (writes subtree.yaml + commits Vendor update with trailers)
swift package --build-path .build/subtree \
  --allow-writing-to-package-directory \
  --allow-network-connections all \
  subtree update openssl --ref <tag>

# 2. Re-extract (--force overwrites previously-extracted sources)
swift package --build-path .build/subtree \
  --allow-writing-to-package-directory \
  subtree extract --name openssl --force

# 3. Verify
swift build && swift test
```

### Full recipe (Configure dance — required when `swift build` fails)

If step 3 fails with missing identifiers like `OSSL_CMP_PKISTATUS_*`, the upstream bump changed a `.h.in` template. Regenerate and re-extract:

```bash
cd Vendor/openssl
./Configure darwin64-arm64-cc no-asm no-shared no-apps no-docs no-tests \
  no-rc5 no-rc2 no-idea no-bf no-cast no-seed no-camellia \
  no-mdc2 no-whirlpool no-md2 no-md4 \
  no-sm2 no-sm3 no-sm4 no-aria no-gost no-blake2 \
  no-lms no-ml-dsa no-ml-kem no-slh-dsa \
  no-ec_nistp_64_gcc_128 no-padlockeng
make build_all_generated
cd ../..

# Re-extract to pick up generated headers + generated .c files
swift package --build-path .build/subtree \
  --allow-writing-to-package-directory \
  subtree extract --name openssl --force

# ALWAYS run distclean after extraction — generated files must NOT be committed to Vendor/
( cd Vendor/openssl && make distclean )

swift build && swift test
```

**Never commit the Configure outputs to `Vendor/openssl/`.** They belong under `Sources/libcrypto/` (extracted from Vendor during step 3). Committing them into Vendor causes conflicts on the next `subtree update`.

## Configure-generated files (extracted, live under `Sources/libcrypto/`)

These files do NOT exist in upstream `Vendor/openssl/` by default — they are generated by `./Configure` + `make build_all_generated`:

- `Sources/libcrypto/include/openssl/configuration.h` — build configuration + `OPENSSL_NO_*` defines
- `Sources/libcrypto/include/openssl/*.h` — headers generated from `.h.in` templates (`cmp.h`, `ssl.h`, `asn1.h`, `bio.h`, `x509.h`, etc. — see `Vendor/openssl/include/openssl/*.h.in`)
- `Sources/libcrypto/internal_include/crypto/buildinf.h` — build info (compiler, date, platform)
- `Sources/libcrypto/providers/providers/fips/include/fips/fipsindicator.h` — FIPS indicator macros
- Generated `.c` files under `providers/` — produced from `.c.in` templates (these get picked up by the 5th extraction mapping on re-extract)

## Algorithm selection

Disabled algorithms are **double-encoded** — both lists MUST stay synchronized:

1. `subtree.yaml` `exclude:` blocks — prevent upstream `.c` / `.h` files from being extracted into `Sources/libcrypto/`.
2. `OPENSSL_NO_*` defines in the generated `Sources/libcrypto/include/openssl/configuration.h` — tell the remaining compiled code that those algorithms are absent.

Adding or removing an algorithm requires touching both: update `subtree.yaml` excludes AND re-run `./Configure` with the corresponding `no-xxx` / (missing) `no-xxx` flag, then `make build_all_generated`, re-extract, `make distclean`.
